name: Steel Dynamics
catalog_text: Steel Dynamics is a premier supplier of high-strength structural Steel Plates (4x8) and heavy duty Fasteners (M8). Custom sizes are available on request.

name: Global Alloys
catalog_text: Global Alloys provides high-performance light metal fasteners, screws, and pure aluminum ingots. They are certified for marine usage and have excellent lead times.

name: Hardware Hub
catalog_text: Hardware Hub offers standard steel hardware, screws and structural sheeting plates. Known for expedited next-day shipping options.
